snippet.title: CyberRace (1993) - PC Futuristic Racing Games
snippet.description:
CyberRace by Cyberdreams, 1993.

An interactive movie crossed with voxel graphic based racing sequences, CyberRace sees your character forced into racing by a slippery politician who steals his girlfriend!

Usually in DOSBox this runs at a million miles an hour, but here I've set cycles to 35000 and am using joypad to play. Luckily I have the instructions so know that F2 shows the amount of laps left and F5 (I think) switches to the exterior cameras, shown at the end of this clip.

It's a bit awkward to play though, and there's only music on the interactive movie sequences (not shown here). The final stages (also not shown) are a Destruction Derby style melee, but here I'm showing some of the actual racing stages instead. Follow the brightly coloured marker pylons!

View the full PC Futuristic Racing Games playlist here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYDobL0b26uijLs3qAzTaFuXl3eSSfmgK
